title: azalea nudiflora var. polyandra
intro: Azalea nudiflora var. polyandra, commonly known as the Himalayan Azalea or Pink Azalea, is a flowering plant species within the heath family, native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Azalea nudiflora var. polyandra include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
